outcome: Incidence of infections in early childhood
cohort: 334 children in the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood 2000 birth cohort
finding: Environmental exposures were associated with the overall rate of infections in the first 3 years of life, but only explained a small fraction of the variation in incidence.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of lower respiratory infections.
